title: 面向投资者微博的语义增强观点感知情感分析
summary: 针对金融情感分析中缺乏情感目标细粒度理解的问题，提出通过声明式LLM流水线为StockEmotions数据集添加语义结构化观点图，增强情感和情绪标签的语义深度。实验表明，引入观点语义可提升图神经网络分类器在不同情绪谱系上的性能。
summary_en: Addressing the lack of fine-grained understanding of sentiment targets in financial NLP, this work augments the StockEmotions dataset with semantically structured opinion graphs via a declarative LLM pipeline, improving GNN-based emotion classification performance.
